description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'EditSocialMediaAuthProviderController' within the OrangeHRM OpenID Authentication plugin. The class extends an abstract base controller and primarily manages the pre-render logic to prepare a Vue component for editing social media authentication providers, depending on whether an 'id' attribute is present in the request.

classes.name: EditSocialMediaAuthProviderController
classes.description: Controller for editing social media authentication providers, extends AbstractVueController, sets up Vue component with conditional 'id' property based on request attributes.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering. Checks for 'id' in request attributes; if present, adds it as a property to the component. Sets the component to be rendered.
